items.title: UB expects Q3 profit growth to moderate on rising costs
items.description: United Breweries expects slower profit growth this quarter as raw material costs and marketing expenses increase. Regulatory delays are inhibiting price increases for nearly 30% of their operations, particularly in southern states. The company forecasts gross margins to decline slightly from the previous quarter's figures. United Breweries is prioritizing profitability over market share in specific regions amid intensified competition.

items.title: Adani Enterprises Q2 net profit falls 55% despite 75% increase in revenue
items.description: Adani Enterprises saw a 55% drop in consolidated net profit for the September quarter. Revenue from operations increased by 75%, reaching ₹37,216 crore compared to the previous year. A notable decline in profit was attributed to an exceptional gain a year prior, while expenses rose sharply. The company plans to invest ₹35,000 crore to ₹40,000 crore annually in airports and data centres.

items.title: HUL sales rise 15% to hit 14-quarter high, but inflation clouds demand outlook
items.description: Hindustan Unilever posted a turnover of ₹18,071 crore for the September quarter, highlighting a 15% rise. Even with a price increase of 7.5%, the company's volume growth remained stable at 7%. Homecare emerged as the standout performer, boasting a robust 22% sales growth. Earnings before interest, tax, depreciation, and amortisation climbed to ₹4,089 crore, an 8% boost. However, ongoing inflation and wage issues in rural sectors pose significant challenges.

items.title: Vedanta cuts debt by Rs 4,624 crore in September quarter as net profit jumps 151%
items.description: Vedanta reported significant financial growth, achieving record revenue and net profit in the September quarter. The company's consolidated revenue increased by 57% year-on-year to ₹25,812 crore while Ebitda doubled to ₹9,938 crore. After a recent demerger, Vedanta plans to eliminate debt, nearing completion in the upcoming quarter. The company has successfully reduced its debt by nearly ₹10,000 crore in recent months. Shares of Vedanta closed 3.

items.title: Asian Paints Q2 Results: Net profit rises 7% YoY to Rs 1,068 crore; firm announces Rs 5.75/share dividend
items.description: Asian Paints Q2 Results: The paint-maker’s revenue from operations increased around 17% YoY to Rs 9,977 crore during the July-September quarter of FY27, from Rs 8,513 crore reported in the corresponding quarter of FY26.

items.title: Jio Q2 Preview: First results after listing tomorrow. What should investors expect?
items.description: Jio Platforms will announce its first quarterly results as a listed company on October 30, with brokerages expecting double-digit revenue growth in Q2 FY27. Nomura projects revenue of Rs 40,400 crore and net profit of Rs 7,610 crore, while subscriber additions and ARPU growth will be key metrics for investors.

items.title: Vedanta Aluminium more than doubles profit; cost cuts in focus to drive earnings
items.description: Vedanta Aluminium’s September-quarter net profit more than doubled, while revenue rose 41% and EBITDA surged 83% year-on-year. The company expects higher production volumes and lower costs to support earnings despite declining aluminium prices. Production costs could fall 6% by year-end, aided by increased captive bauxite availability and operational efficiencies.

items.title: Vedanta Aluminium reports 41% revenue growth to Rs 22,066 crore in September quarter
items.description: In the September quarter, Vedanta Aluminium experienced a remarkable 41% growth in revenue year-on-year. Despite predictions of falling aluminium prices, production is on the rise due to enhanced capacity. The company forecasts a reduction in production costs by 6% by year's end. Operational enhancements indicate that earnings will still rise, positioning Vedanta positively amid shifting market conditions.

items.title: PVR Inox Q2 profit rises 111% to Rs 273 crore, targets 500 new screens in 3 years
items.description: PVR INOX plans an ambitious expansion, targeting to unveil around 90 to 100 new screens in FY 2027 and 150 to 175 in FY 2028. With a focus on Tier 2 to 4 markets, they'll introduce their innovative SMART Cinema format. Estimated capital expenditure for FY 27 is projected at ₹300-320 crore, adhering to a capital-light approach.

items.title: Pidilite Industries reports 7% YoY growth in net profit to Rs 626 crore
items.description: Pidilite Industries has achieved a remarkable 7% growth in consolidated net profit for the September quarter, with profits hitting ₹626 crore. This success is underpinned by a substantial increase in total revenue, soaring by over 21% to reach ₹4,285 crore. However, challenges such as tighter margins and rising input costs have tempered profit growth. Notably, the consumer segment saw a robust 20.

items.title: JSW Energy Q2 profit jumps 50%; 3 gigawatt target on track
items.description: JSW Energy has reported a 49.9% year-on-year increase in consolidated net profit for the second quarter. The company's consolidated revenue from operations rose by 23%, showcasing significant growth over the last year. During this quarter, JSW Energy added 813 MW of capacity, including substantial renewable energy projects. The company aims to achieve a capacity addition target of 3 GW by the end of FY27.

items.title: Adani Ports reports 18% net profit rise to Rs 3,682 crore in Q2 FY27
items.description: Adani Ports and Special Economic Zone showcased a remarkable 18% increase in consolidated net profit for the September quarter. With a year-on-year revenue surge of 24% amounting to ₹11,340.4 crore, this growth stemmed from a spike in cargo volumes. The firm has also revised upward its FY27 revenue and capital expenditure targets, attributed significantly to robust performance in domestic operations and impressive strides in international growth.

items.title: Ambuja Cements’ profit slumps 90% on higher costs, high previous-year base
items.description: Ambuja Cements reported a 90% year-on-year profit decline to ₹236 crore in Q2 FY27 as rising fuel, logistics and operating costs squeezed margins. Revenue remained flat at ₹9,197 crore, while EBITDA fell 28%, prompting renewed cost-control efforts.

items.title: Milky Mist Q2 revenue surges 42% YoY, EBITDA soars 54%
items.description: Milky Mist Dairy Food recorded 41.6% year-on-year revenue growth in Q2 FY27, achieving record quarterly revenue and gross profit. Strong demand for value-added dairy, protein products and yoghurt drove growth, while first-half profit after tax surged 308.4%.

items.title: Brigade Group reports 29% growth in Q2 net profit at Rs 219 crore
items.description: Brigade Group reported a 29% year-on-year profit increase to ₹219 crore in Q2 FY27, despite lower revenue. Strong residential bookings, higher operating profit, robust leasing performance and hospitality growth supported earnings, while new project launches strengthened its development pipeline.

items.title: Vedanta Power Q2 results: Company swings to profit at Rs 83 crore; revenue rises 38% YoY
items.description: Vedanta Power reported a turnaround in Q2 FY27, posting ₹83 crore profit against a ₹1,688 crore loss last year. Revenue rose 38% to ₹2,908 crore, while EBITDA surged 122%, supported by record power sales and improved operations.

items.title: Motilal Oswal Q2 Results: PAT nearly quadruples to Rs 1,070 crore; revenue up 20%
items.description: Motilal Oswal reported a 29% year-on-year rise in operating profit to ₹718 crore in Q2 FY27, driven by asset management and wealth management growth. Assets under management expanded, while recurring revenue strengthened earnings visibility and business resilience.

items.title: Godrej Consumer Q2 Results: Profit rises 14% YoY to Rs 523 crore, revenue jumps 19%; co declares Rs 5/share dividend
items.description: Godrej Consumer Products posted 13.8% profit growth to ₹522.92 crore and 19% revenue growth to ₹4,413.09 crore in Q2 FY27. Strong international performance, expanding home care brands and a ₹5 interim dividend supported its outlook for sustained growth.

items.title: Suzlon Energy Q2 Results: Profit plunges 69% YoY to Rs 394 crore due to one-time deferred tax
items.description: Suzlon Energy reported a 69% year-on-year profit decline to ₹394 crore in Q2 FY27, despite 26% revenue growth to ₹4,869 crore. Record turbine deliveries, a 6,009 MW order book and a ₹2,048 crore net cash position strengthened its outlook.

items.title: ESAF Small Finance Bank posts Rs 160 crore Q2 profit as asset quality improves
items.description: ESAF Small Finance Bank reported a net profit of Rs 160 crore in Q2, reversing a Rs 116 crore loss in the year-ago period. Improved margins, lower provisions and stronger asset quality supported the turnaround, while advances and deposits grew 25% and 24%, respectively.

items.title: Trent Q2 Results: Cons profit jumps 25% YoY to Rs 468 crore; revenue climbs 22%
items.description: Trent Q2 Results: Trent reported a 25.3% year-on-year rise in Q2 FY27 consolidated net profit to Rs 468 crore, while revenue grew 21.9% to Rs 5,873 crore. EBITDA rose 29.6% to Rs 1,054 crore, with margins improving to 18.2%. The retailer expanded its footprint across Westside, Zudio and other lifestyle concepts.

items.title: IndiGo Q2 Results: Loss narrows YoY to Rs 1,879 crore; revenue rises 26%
items.description: IndiGo Q2 Results: Budget airline IndiGo reported narrowing of its consolidated loss to Rs 1,879 crore in the second quarter of FY27, compared with Rs 2,582 crore in the year-ago quarter. However, the loss widened from Rs 237 crore posted in the preceding June quarter.

items.title: RIL Q2 Results Preview: Profit outlook brightens as O2C business set to drive growth
items.description: Reliance Industries is expected to report 15-17% year-on-year growth in September-quarter EBITDA, driven by a sharp recovery in its oil-to-chemicals business. Brokerages expect stronger refining margins, higher throughput and a weaker rupee to offset subdued retail and oil and gas performance. Investors will track O2C profitability, Jio Platforms’ earnings and retail margins as RIL announces results.

items.title: Ambuja Cements Q2 Results: Net profit tanks 90% YoY to Rs 114 crore on tax reversal effect; revenue rises 10%
items.description: Ambuja Cements Q2 Results: The company reported a 90% year-on-year decline in Q2 FY27 net profit to Rs 114 crore due to a Rs 1,697 crore income tax provision reversal in the year-ago quarter. Revenue rose 10% to Rs 6,113 crore. Shareholders also approved the proposed amalgamation of ACC and Orient Cement with Ambuja, with completion expected in FY27, subject to approvals.
